Which statement about aluminium is correct?
A
Aluminium is easy to extract from its ore because it is near the bottom of the reactivity
series.
B
Aluminium is formed when aluminium oxide is heated with carbon.
C
Bauxite is an important ore of aluminium.
D
Hematite is an important ore of aluminium.
